description: Defines the ProofSourceX509 class for handling X.509 certificates with private keys in the QUIC protocol implementation, including methods for creating proof sources, retrieving certificates, and computing TLS signatures.

classes.name: ProofSourceX509
classes.description: A class that manages X.509 certificates with private keys, selecting certificates based on SubjectAltName, and providing cryptographic proof for QUIC.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new ProofSourceX509 instance with a default certificate chain and key.

methods.name: GetProof
methods.description: Generates a cryptographic proof for the server.

methods.name: GetCertChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain matching the hostname.

methods.name: ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Computes a TLS signature using the private key.

methods.name: GetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Returns the ticket crypter used for session tickets.

methods.name: AddCertificateChain
methods.description: Adds a certificate chain to the verifier, overriding older certificates with the same SubjectAltName.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the default certificate is valid.

methods.name: MaybeAddSctsForHostname
methods.description: Provides SCTs for a given hostname, can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: GetCertificate
methods.description: Looks up the certificate for a hostname, returning the default if none matches.
